technical-summary: The forced placement driver (RHP06/RHP11 forced churn) issues no proposal until the engine has published a request ticket (Header::publish_sequence != 0). Before that the engine may still be initialising its mailbox kernels, which refuse to start while a transaction is in flight ('called in the wrong phase'; 1 of 5 KL passes on flashnext-4gpu), and a KL run saw every swap complete before its first scored position. Test: a fresh segment gets no proposal; after the first published ticket the 1,000-transition schedules run as before.
user-summary-candidate: Forced expert-churn test runs now start swapping only once the engine is serving, so they no longer race engine start-up and their swaps land during the measured work.
